description: Lets every build in the workspace reach one outside service: one a build is waiting on (whats_waiting lists them) or one the person names. Use it only when the person says the service is theirs or one they use. Builds already reach public services by themselves. Paste and file-drop sites are never allowed. Only owners and admins can allow one.

host.description: The service's web address, such as api.yourbookings.com (a pasted link works too).

reason.description: Why, in a sentence: kept in the workspace's activity.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: allow_build_access
title: Let builds use a service
